summary: Read conversation message bodies from --body-file PATH or --body - (also -m -) without shell interpolation.

compatibility.detail: conversations send requires exactly one of --body and --body-file. A body value of - now reads stdin. File and stdin bodies require valid UTF-8, preserve whitespace, and share the existing 256 KiB message limit. Help shows single-quoted text and a quoted heredoc to avoid shell expansion.

manual.detail: Existing literal argv bodies remain supported; use file or stdin input for command-containing text.
